description: This file contains C source code implementing JSON parsing and extraction functions, including selecting objects, retrieving values, and handling JSON arrays, with internal static helper functions and externally visible API functions.

methods.name: dmjson_select_obj
methods.description: Selects a nested JSON object based on a sequence of keys.

methods.name: dmjson_print_value
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to its string representation based on its type.

methods.name: ____dmjson_get_value_in_obj
methods.description: Retrieves the string value of a nested JSON object given a sequence of keys.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_value_in_obj
methods.description: Public API to get a value in a JSON object using variable arguments for keys.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_obj
methods.description: Public API to get a nested JSON object using variable arguments for keys.

methods.name: ____dmjson_select_obj_in_array_idx
methods.description: Selects a JSON object within an array at a specified index, possibly nested.

methods.name: __dmjson_select_obj_in_array_idx
methods.description: Selects a JSON object within an array at a specified index with variable keys.

methods.name: ____dmjson_get_value_in_array_idx
methods.description: Retrieves the string value from a JSON array at a specified index, possibly nested.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_value_in_array_idx
methods.description: Public API to get a string value from a JSON array at a specified index with default fallback.

methods.name: ____dmjson_get_value_array_all
methods.description: Concatenates all values from a JSON array matching specified keys, separated by delimiter.

methods.name: __dmjson_get_value_array_all
methods.description: Public API to concatenate all values from a JSON array with specified keys.
